## Source and method

- https://bitbucket.org/bluetooth-SIG/public

Read on 2026-10-17 from the Bluetooth SIG's public repository (https://bitbucket.org/bluetooth-SIG/public), branch main at commit 408f4a0305d87ea75d9f700e3c8f85aa1d3a74fd (committed 2026-10-14), as one archive of that commit: service and characteristic UUIDs from assigned_numbers/uuids, unit names from units.yaml, service ties from the permitted-characteristics files, and each characteristic's structure from its GATT Specification Supplement file in gss/. The 97 characteristics are an allow-list chosen for fitness and health devices, the SIG's User Data list and the characteristics those structures refer to (see scripts/fetch-bluetooth-gatt.mjs). One row per structure field, a struct's fields as rows under it, and one row per characteristic with no structure in the repository. Derived columns keep their evidence: flagBit and flagValue are parsed only from a "Present if bit N of … field is set to V" line, which is published in presentIf; units are the org.bluetooth.unit ids in the field's text, with the line in unitEvidence; an offset is set only where every earlier size is a plain number, else null with the varying fields in offsetVariesWith. sigService is set only where a permitted-characteristics file names the characteristic; no other file in the repository ties characteristics to services.

## Fields

| Field | Description | JSON types | Null in |
|---|---|---|---|
| `characteristicUuid` | The 16-bit UUID as characteristic_uuids.yaml writes it | string | 0 of 378 rows |
| `characteristicName` | The characteristic's name in characteristic_uuids.yaml | string | 0 of 378 rows |
| `characteristicId` | The characteristic's identifier, e.g. org.bluetooth.characteristic.heart_rate_measurement | string | 0 of 378 rows |
| `sigService` | The service a permitted-characteristics file lists it under; null where no file does | null, string | 318 of 378 rows |
| `structurePublished` | yes when the repository has a gss file for the characteristic | string | 0 of 378 rows |
| `order` | Position in the structure; "3.1" is the first field of the struct at position 3; null where no structure is published | null, string | 7 of 378 rows |
| `field` | The field name, verbatim | null, string | 7 of 378 rows |
| `parentField` | For a struct's field, the structure field it belongs to | null, string | 342 of 378 rows |
| `type` | The gss type (or a struct row's data_type), verbatim | null, string | 7 of 378 rows |
| `size` | The size as published: "1", "0 or 2", "variable", "0–18"… | null, string | 7 of 378 rows |
| `sizeUnit` | octets, or bits where the struct is marked size_in_bits | null, string | 7 of 378 rows |
| `offset` | DERIVED: the sum of the earlier sizes, only where every one is a plain number; relative to the struct for a struct's field | integer, null | 182 of 378 rows |
| `offsetVariesWith` | The earlier fields whose size is not a plain number, when offset is null | null, string | 203 of 378 rows |
| `presentIf` | The field's "Present if …" line(s), verbatim; null where it has none | null, string | 180 of 378 rows |
| `flagsField` | DERIVED: the flags field presentIf names, when it parses as one flag bit | null, string | 189 of 378 rows |
| `flagBit` | DERIVED: the bit presentIf names | integer, null | 189 of 378 rows |
| `flagValue` | DERIVED: the value (0 or 1) presentIf requires | integer, null | 189 of 378 rows |
| `units` | DERIVED: the org.bluetooth.unit ids in the field's text | null, string | 147 of 378 rows |
| `unitEvidence` | The line each unit id was read from, verbatim | null, string | 147 of 378 rows |
| `gssFile` | The SIG's gss file at the commit read | null, string | 7 of 378 rows |
| `page` | This site's row for the field (or the hub row where the characteristic has no page) | string | 0 of 378 rows |

A null means the source does not state the value or it could not be verified. It never means zero, and it is never a guess. In the CSV a null is an empty unquoted field.

## Update cadence

- `src/data/bluetoothGatt.ts` is generated by `scripts/fetch-bluetooth-gatt.mjs` from the sources above, last read 2026-10-17.
- `.github/workflows/bluetooth-gatt.yml` runs it on the schedule `33 5 * * 3` (cron, UTC).
- The files are rebuilt by `npm run datasets` (scripts/build-datasets.mjs); a run with no source change writes byte-identical files. The edition stays 2026.1, and a new edition ships under a new file name rather than overwriting this one.
